description.value: Kin Thai Kitchen is an authentic Thai restaurant situated in the Morgan Crossing area of Grandview Corners in South Surrey, offering an extensive menu of classic Thai dishes with a customizable spice-level system ranging from mild to Thai Hot. The restaurant accommodates individuals and groups alike, and can host private and business functions. Both dine-in and takeout are available, and the menu includes vegetarian and gluten-free options alongside traditional Thai cocktails and a wine list.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and provides strong evidence. Takeout is explicitly confirmed ('We are open for Dine in and Take Out!!!') and vegetarian/GF options are confirmed in the About Us page ('Our menu, including vegetarian and gluten-free options'). No mention of bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or water refill anywhere on the site. A unit number discrepancy exists: OSM tags addr:unit='23' but the website consistently lists the address as '50-2443 161a Street', so the website value is preferred and the discrepancy is flagged. OSM name includes '& Bar' but the website only uses 'Kin Thai Kitchen'.
concerns: Unit number discrepancy: OSM addr:unit='23' but website consistently shows unit 50 (e.g., '50-2443 161a Street'). Website value used for address field.
OSM name is 'Kin Thai Kitchen & Bar' but the website uses 'Kin Thai Kitchen' without '& Bar' throughout.
Phone number not present in OSM tags; sourced from website only.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: An active dine-in and takeout Thai restaurant with vegetarian and GF options in South Surrey; a useful food stop for touring cyclists in the Morgan Crossing area.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: About Us page states 'Our menu, including vegetarian and gluten-free options, is also available for take-out.' Menu includes a dedicated Vegetarian Delight dish and spring rolls marked as veg
